title: Fix five Test Suite failures on main
objective: Make the full Test Suite green on main (23dc060e) by repairing the root cause of each of the five failures that have been red since at least 8b62bfb3, without weakening any gate, skipping any test, or loosening any assertion.
success_criteria: V1: no module outside ops/scripts/org_dotgithub.py calls the <owner>/.github REST route, and the org_template_read probe still reports a REST-only per-transport verdict
V2: test_egress_boundary.py passes because the two Memory 3.0 OAuth audience files are allowlisted with a CANONICAL_LAW §8.10 reason, not because a forbidden token was removed from the scanner
V3: test_commit_verification_validator.py passes because integrate.py no longer emits core.hooksPath=/dev/null, with the integration skill's own tests still green
V4: test_resolve_changed_files_merge_base.py passes on a checkout with zero commits ahead of origin/main and still proves a real change set resolves to `comparison`

out: Changing ops/scripts/validate_memory_egress_boundary.py forbidden tokens or enforce mode
Changing the commit-verification contract or adding a breakglass
